subject: Warm-handshake: Helios Systems demo + security liaison
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Helios inbound — self-serve sign-up, wants AE+SE+IT on demo

Hi team,

Quick intro: Helios Systems (Anya Petrova is our contact) completed a self-serve trial and wants a rapid walkthrough focused on integration and security. Key asks from their intake form: data residency concerns, firewall/egress requirements, and an architecture-level Q&A with our SE + their IT/security present.

Why this matters: Helios is evaluating for a fleet-edge inference pilot (industrial telemetry) — medium ACV but fast timeline (pilot decision in 2–3 weeks).

Suggested approach: 60-minute demo + 15-minute post-call reserved for procurement questions. Ideally AE (karthik) + SE (soojin) + one of us to coordinate logistics.

Availability they listed (BST):
 - Tue Aug 18: 14:00–16:00 BST
 - Wed Aug 19: 09:00–11:00 BST
 - Thu Aug 20: 13:00–15:00 BST

I started a HubSpot deal (DL-9372) and attached the Helios intake/security spreadsheet (helios-security-reqs.pdf). Can you confirm who can own the demo and which of the listed slots work?

Thanks — I'll warm-hand off on the call.
— Jasmine
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helios inbound — self-serve sign-up, wants AE+SE+IT on demo

Thanks Jasmine — looping Karthik and Soojin.

Karthik: can you own AE for this one? Looks like a product-led lead with procurement on a fast timeline; we should keep the session tight (60 min) and get IT on for the first 20–30 min.

Soojin: please review the attached security PDF and flag any pre-call requirements (VPN, allowlist IPs, example logs) — if we need a pre-call test, we can do 10 minutes before the demo.

I propose three concrete slot options (I converted to Redwood / CA times for convenience):
 1) Tue Aug 18 14:00 BST = Tue Aug 18 06:00 PT / 09:00 ET (early for us but doable)
 2) Wed Aug 19 09:30 BST = Wed Aug 19 01:30 PT / 04:30 ET
 3) Thu Aug 20 14:00 BST = Thu Aug 20 06:00 PT / 09:00 ET

Please reply with which slot you can commit to and whether you prefer the IT presence for the entire hour or just the first half. I'll send a calendar invite once we lock it and include an agenda. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/DL-9372

If none of the above works, propose 2 alternatives in the next 48h.

— Chloe
Solutions Ops (Scheduling)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 12:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Helios inbound — self-serve sign-up, wants AE+SE+IT on demo

Thanks — happy to own AE. I can do:
 - Tue Aug 18 at the earlier slot (14:00 BST) — I'm available 13:30–15:30 BST (that fits)
 - Thu Aug 20 would also work if we need to move.

I prefer IT to attend the first 30 minutes for architecture/egress questions and then we can demo flows and discuss pricing/next steps in the second half.

One ask: I'm on a flight morning of Aug 19 but land midday, so Wed is tight. If we lock Tue 14:00 BST that's best.

Also recommend a 10-minute tech check 15 minutes before the call (Soojin + Helios IT) to confirm firewall rules and sharing.

— Karthik
Account Executive
From: Anya Petrova <anya@helios-systems.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@helios-systems.com>, IT Security <it-security@helios-systems.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 09:21:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Warm-handshake: Helios Systems demo + security liaison

Hi Chloe / team,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Our IT team has a maintenance window Mon–Tue mornings (08:00–09:30 BST) so they can't do early-table slots those days. Samir (copied) is our lead and prefers afternoons between 13:00–16:00 BST.

Concrete preference: Tue Aug 18 at 14:00 BST or Thu Aug 20 at 14:00 BST. If you pick Tue, Samir will join for the first 35 minutes then pass to our product owner.

We'd like the session to focus first on network/ingress and data flow (15–25 min), then a short live demo (25–30 min), and finish with procurement next steps.

I attached a short internal checklist — happy to fill any pre-reqs.

Best,
Anya
Director, Edge Integrations — Helios Systems
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Anya Petrova <anya@helios-systems.com>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@helios-systems.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Warm-handshake: Helios Systems demo + security liaison

Thanks — I reviewed the helios-security-reqs.pdf. A couple of quick asks before we go live:
 - Please confirm egress allowlist IPs (we need these to whitelist tokens/callbacks).
 - If Helios plans to send telemetry through a private VPC peering, share a high-level CIDR and sample payload size.
 - For the demo, 45 minutes is ideal: 20–25 min tech Q&A (with Samir), 20 min demo, 5 min next steps.

I can do the Tue Aug 18 14:00 BST slot. I will join the 10-minute tech check at 13:50 BST (that's 05:50 PT). If Helios prefers, I can share a brief architecture diagram in advance.

— Soojin
Senior Solutions Engineer
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Anya Petrova <anya@helios-systems.com>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@helios-systems.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2026 13:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Warm-handshake: Helios Systems demo + security liaison

All set — locking Tue Aug 18 14:00–14:45 BST (45 min) with a 10-minute tech check at 13:50 BST.

Calendar invite (attached calendar-invite.ics) and agenda (demo-agenda-helio.pdf) are included.

Agenda highlights:
 - 13:50 BST: tech check (Soojin + Samir) — verify allowlist & test connectivity
 - 14:00 BST: intro + architecture / data residency (Samir, Soojin) — 20 min
 - 14:20 BST: live demo (Karthik) — 20 min
 - 14:40 BST: procurement / next steps (Jasmine + Karthik) — 5 min

Action items before the tech check:
 1) Helios (Samir): confirm egress allowlist IPs and whether you plan to peer into a private VPC (reply to thread).
 2) Soojin: please upload a 1-slide architecture diagram to the Drive linked here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HeliosDemoPack
 3) Jasmine: please update HubSpot (DL-9372) with participant list and this confirmed slot.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the session.

— Chloe
Solutions Ops (Scheduling)

Attachments referenced: helios-security-reqs.pdf, demo-agenda-helio.pdf, calendar-invite.ics
